description: Abstract class for AMQP-based Hono endpoints, providing link management and verification methods.

classes.name: AbstractAmqpEndpoint
classes.description: Abstract base class for AMQP endpoints, handling configuration, link detachment, and attachment logic.

methods.name: setConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the configuration properties for the endpoint, requiring non-null input.

methods.name: onLinkDetach
methods.description: Closes a link to a ProtonReceiver or ProtonLink, optionally with an error condition.

methods.name: onLinkAttach
methods.description: Handles link attachment requests, rejecting unsupported operations with NOT_IMPLEMENTED error.

methods.name: passesFormalVerification
methods.description: Abstract method to verify if a message passes formal checks before processing.
